steps.description: Research popular sports-themed birthday party ideas and compile a list of themes and decorations.
Fetch images and examples of decorations and party supplies related to the selected sports themes.
Identify nearby stores or online vendors that sell sports-themed party decorations and supplies.
Gather accurate and up-to-date predictions for upcoming sports matches relevant to the party theme.
Compile the predictions into a presentable format suitable for sharing at the party.
